o.text: Internationalism. Borrowed from Russian февра́ль (fevrálʹ), from Old East Slavic феврарь (fevrarĭ), феуларь (feularĭ), from Old Church Slavonic февроуари (fevruari), from Medieval Greek Φεβρουάριος (Phebrouários), from Latin Februārius.

Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish بلچق (balçıq), from Proto-Oghuz بَلْجِقْ (balçıq), from Proto-Turkic *balčïk. Cognate with Turkish balçık, Tatar and Crimean Tatar balçıq, Bashkir балсыҡ (balsıq), etc.
Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *tart- (“to pull; to hang”). Cognate with Turkish tartmak, Chuvash турт (turt).
